run_doctest_module: run the doctest suite for the Boost.Python defaults test module
test_bar_function: test the bar free function with default arguments for int, char, string, and double
test_foo_function: test the foo free function with default arguments for int, char, string, and double
test_class_x_methods: test class X methods bar, foo, bar2, and get_state with various default argument combinations
extract_docstring_lines: extract specific lines from a Boost.Python bound object docstring using selected_doc helper
